newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen SEZ Real Estate net 1.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen SEZ Real Estate net 1.7 mln.

text.p: Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Real Estate & Property Group Co Ltd had a net profit of 1.695 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Friday.
Turnover was 775.04 million yuan in 1996, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
In 1995, the company posted net profits of 392.41 million yuan on turnover of 1.19 billion yuan under Chinese accounting standards. It did not give figures based on international standards.
The firm proposed no dividend for 1996, the exchange said.
